clusters.description: Event-driven coupling where backend domain changes (promotions/subscriptions) propagate to UI views using observer-like broadcasting rather than direct polling.

clusters.description: MVC-style responsibilities for orchestrating user journeys such as order history, promotions browsing, and subscription management, focusing on view/controller separation.

clusters.description: How search and availability/dietary constraints are modeled using specifications, capturing variation in query composition and rule encapsulation.

clusters.name: Location-Based Map Facade for Item Discovery
clusters.description: Using a facade to hide map-provider complexity behind a stable interface for location-driven discovery and selection interactions.

clusters.name: User Authentication and Secure Credential Storage
clusters.description: Account security architectures covering credential encryption and access control, distinct from UI workflows, search, or data integration concerns.

clusters.name: User Registration Validation and Confirmation Flow
clusters.description: Registration UX/business rules capturing form validation and confirmation steps, distinct from authentication storage and from domain browsing flows.

iterations.explanation: I refined the taxonomy by adding one orthogonal dimension: explicit domain modeling for user profiles and transactional entities. New data includes repository creation for profiles, meals, and orders; existing dimension 1 covers the repository/persistence pattern, while a separate axis is needed for what entities and domain invariants are being modeled. The remaining items (authentication mechanism, MVC UI coordination, adapter strategy for maps, facade-style map interface) map cleanly to existing dimensions, so no merges/splits were required.
